title: Жена известного футболиста  (The Famous Footballer's Wife)

segments.t: Vika returns to the kitchen and tells Chef Barinov that the woman asking for her tartare to be fried is the wife of a famous Russian football player. Instantly intrigued, the football-obsessed Chef demands to know whether her husband plays for his beloved Spartak Moscow.
